[Phase 1 Collective_Subconscious 子 task] 寫 docs/Subconscious/retro_template.md — 一份 retro 流程 template 規範. 包含 4 段: WHAT (事實) / WHY (5-why 根因) / PROCESS FIX (改流程) / NOT (避免「妳怎麼又錯了」個人歸責). 對齊 Plan_Collective_Subconscious §5. 純 doc, 15 min 內可 ship. 完工 commit hash 寫進 Bartender assign_ack done.

[Phase 1 Collective_Subconscious 子 task] 寫 AgentCommands/Subconscious/anti_patterns.jsonl seed entries — 5 條 pattern: early-clockout / abort-for-convenience / ding-ack-no-read / amend-violation / marathon-no-relay-followup. 每條依 Plan_Collective_Subconscious §3 schema (pattern_id / name / severity / detection_rule / example_violation / skill_ref / first_detected_at / violation_count / last_violator). 純 jsonl append. 完工 ack done 帶 commit hash.

[Phase 1 Collective_Subconscious 子 task] 寫 AgentCommands/Subconscious/subconscious.py skeleton — Python CLI 包含 (a) detect <pattern_id> --context X subcmd, 讀 anti_patterns.jsonl 查 rule, 回 hit/miss + alert payload (b) record_violation entry → violations.jsonl + increment violation_count (c) 串 tavern_post 走 subprocess fire alert. 純 skeleton 不必完整實作 detection rule, 留 TODO. ~30 LOC. 完工 ack done 帶 commit hash.
